capabilities: Render a gallery code block as an image/video slider
Edit captions as Markdown notes linked to gallery media
Build galleries from a vault folder, an explicit file list, or both
Control video playback with play, mute, loop and fragment ranges
Position and resize the caption panel around the media
extras: Desktop only; mobile support is planned after touch testing. Only local vault media is supported; remote URLs, YouTube embeds, autoplay, grid layouts and audio are planned future work.
intentEvidence: keep media in your vault, keep captions as ordinary Markdown notes, and edit those captions directly inside the gallery
motivation: The README states its main idea is to keep media in the vault and captions as ordinary Markdown notes, editable directly inside the gallery.
problem: Obsidian can display embedded media but has no native way to present a folder or list of local images and videos as a navigable gallery with editable, searchable captions.
summary: Renders a fenced gallery code block as a slider for local images and videos, with captions stored and edited as regular Markdown notes.
